templates.title: Community Anchor Impact Grant (ZIP {zip})
templates.description: Supports neighborhood-based initiatives expanding access to education, housing stability, or workforce readiness. Applicants outline how services will reach residents within {zip} and adjacent census tracts.
eligibility_bullets: Funds used for direct services, not capital campaigns
Submission includes two community partner letters

templates.title: Resilience Boost Opportunity (ZIP {zip})
templates.description: Provides flexible grants for nonprofits addressing food access, mental health, or emergency financial assistance within the {zip} service area. Award can cover staffing, outreach, and technology tools.
eligibility_bullets: Applicant demonstrates measurable impact in ZIP {zip}
Quarterly reporting on outcomes is required

templates.title: Infrastructure Spark Fund (ZIP {zip})
templates.description: Capital grants for technology, vehicle, or facility upgrades that accelerate service delivery for residents living in or commuting to {zip}. Priority for projects removing accessibility barriers.
eligibility_bullets: Project benefits clients residing in ZIP {zip}
Applicant submits sustainability plan covering 3 years
Matching funds not required but strengthens competitiveness
